ch3_s1_evidence: Ada: The plans describe the stylus carrying a trace. The bypass diagram instead shows a physical linkage: counterweight down, gate up. A password is not the documented release.

Ada: Nessa called the shaft a moving-load hazard and locked its access gate. Sera described lowering the counterweight into its cradle from the tower with nobody in the chamber. Inspection comes before considering use.

Ada: The diagram shows counterweight down, gate up. Sera named that the emergency gravity release, opening the bypass to equalize pressure. Nessa and Sera still require inspection; the old drawing does not certify today’s hardware.
ch3_s2_evidence: Ada: Sera described the apparatus as carrying a trace, not a spoken voice. Tomas prepared the dated magnetic reel before we listened; blank chronograph paper is not the source of that historical audio.
Ada: Tomas identified the reel as a physical magnetic recording made in 1998, with manufacture, leader and time announcement that fit. The historical voices we heard came from that recording.
Ada: We documented the handle as part of the cup event. Tomas prepared and dated a magnetic reel for the historical voices; the handle is not that recording.
ch3_s2a_evidence: Ada: We listed photographs, drawings, readings, timestamps and video that can be preserved safely. Sera warned that keeping the apparatus operating adds unquantified risk. Preserving that record and making the installation safe are our revised objectives.

Ada: Sera said operating a hazardous system to prevent skepticism is not an acceptable safety objective. We can preserve what we observed without promising universal agreement or keeping the active effect running.
Ada: We agreed there would be no secret restart. The damaged pressure path is to remain isolated until qualified assessment and authorization; curiosity does not replace that boundary.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: The path to the lower works begins behind a locked gate and follows the cliff on the landward side of a steel rail. Nessa checks the tide mark before unlocking it. Sera checks the forecast. You check the soles of the boots Nessa lent you. None of the precautions makes the descent feel adventurous, which is probably the point.

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: We have forty minutes in the chamber before this path becomes a bad choice. We leave earlier if the gauge reaches yellow. Nobody negotiates with yellow.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: I have set a timer for thirty. Ten minutes of margin is not ten minutes to spend.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Understood.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: The tide chamber is a natural hollow enlarged by human impatience. Rough basalt gives way to poured concrete halfway along its floor. Pipes run into the rock as if the cliff has been fitted with plumbing. Through a thick green inspection window, a column of water stands higher than the sea outside. It trembles at the top without spilling.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: How is it holding that height?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Pressure difference. An upper reservoir, a lower sea inlet, and a narrow return. Most of what you're looking at is ordinary engineering. The part in the middle is why I'm here.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: She directs a torch at a dark annulus surrounding the inspection window. It looks like glass until the light passes across it. Then layers appear inside, repeating at angles that refuse to settle into a single reflection.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: A naturally occurring resonant inclusion in the basalt. The surveyors named it phase glass. That is a historical label, not a claim that it is literally glass. The builders arranged the water path around it instead of breaking through it.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Why?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: According to the proposal, it produced pressure responses before the measured input. At first they thought there was an error in the instruments. That was a sensible place to begin.

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: Then somebody wanted to sell early flood warnings.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Yes. Another sensible ambition. It doesn't excuse the jump from an ambition to a reliable service.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Sera sets a caliper across two exposed reference bolts and compares the distance with the maintenance sheet. She reads the number twice. Nessa writes it down once, then repeats it back. The little ritual from the harbor office has followed you underground.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: The pressure path is coupled to the tower's chronograph. A stylus can receive motion from this loop. There is also an input platen upstairs, where a person can drive a stylus manually. The plans are specific about what travels: a trace, not an object. Not a mind. Not a spoken voice.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Handwriting, if somebody moves the input stylus by hand.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Exactly. No scanning software needed. A mechanical signal can be as individual as the movement producing it.

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: And the bell?

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Sera points to a heavy rod running up through the roof. A diagram beside it shows the tower bell counterweight, an arresting cradle, and a gate in the bypass pipe. On the diagram the motion is simple: counterweight descends, gate rises. In the chamber, the gate's rusted housing looks less willing to be simple.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Emergency gravity release. Lower the counterweight into its cradle, open the bypass, equalize the pressure. It was designed to be operated from the tower with nobody in this chamber. It also looks as though it has not completed a full cycle in years.

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: So we inspect before we consider using it.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Yes. A historical drawing is not a certificate for today's hardware.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Ask what the machine can and cannot transmit.

conversation.prompt: Ask what the machine can and cannot transmit.
suggestions: Could it send a person or change somebody's memory?
What is the safest thing we can test?
conversation.fallback: The documented path carries stylus motion through pressure coupling. We have no evidence for people, memories, or voices crossing it. We can test a short pattern with clocks and an empty exclusion zone.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: The green column rises by the width of a coin. Nessa taps the gauge with one finger, not to change its reading but to direct your attention. Still below yellow. Sera photographs the position and ends the inspection four minutes before her timer would have sounded.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: You've still got time.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: We've got what we came to measure. Staying because we budgeted longer would be a strange kind of thrift.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: On the way out, you notice a small carved boat set in a crevice above the reach of ordinary spray. Its paint has worn away except for one blue patch. Nessa pauses when she sees you looking.

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: Ewan made those. Left one in every station he serviced. Said machinery deserved a mascot.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Does Tomas know this one is here?

requiredPassages.speaker: nessa
requiredPassages.text: Yes. He asked us to leave it where his father put it.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You leave it. Not every object that matters needs to come upstairs with a catalogue number.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Review the evidence before continuing.

activity.prompt: Which documented mechanism opens the bypass?
options: The receiving pen writes a special password.
The counterweight descends into its clear cradle and lifts the gate.
activity.explanation: The gravity linkage is physical. It must be inspected and operated with the shaft clear.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Tomas has prepared the original reel while you were below. A printed card beside the recorder reads SOURCE, COPY, INTERPRETATION. Under source lies the reel. Under copy lies a storage drive. Under interpretation lies nothing yet. The blank space feels less alarming than the blank chronograph strip. It means someone is waiting to know enough.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Before we listen, I need to say something obvious because the tower is making obvious things feel uncertain. This tape does not come from the future. It is a physical magnetic recording made in 1998. Its manufacture, leader, and recorded time announcement all fit that. The extraordinary device is not an excuse to stop dating ordinary objects.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: So if we hear Ivo describing that night, he was describing it then or in a later recording. Not calling back from tomorrow.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Correct. And if a later voice edited it, we should be able to look for a splice or discontinuity. Not perfectly, but usefully.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Two mechanisms, two sets of claims.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: He plays the leader announcement. An operator names the station, date, and channels. There is a brief calibration tone that feels unpleasant without being loud; Tomas lowers it immediately. Then the voices begin. The recording is not theatrical. People wait for replies. Someone asks for a repetition. Someone coughs through a measurement.

requiredPassages.speaker: ivo
requiredPassages.text: West reading stable at this observation. That is not a vessel hold. Repeat: level stable. Harbor movement remains Channel B.

requiredPassages.speaker: operator
requiredPassages.text: Received, station. Level stable. Harbor movement B.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Tomas stops the tape. In the silence, the fluorescent light above the door hums at a different pitch from the recorder's motor.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: He said it explicitly.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: At this point, yes. This is before the recorded instruction goes missing from the public copy.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: We should note both. He understood the distinction. That may matter to what he accepted later.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: The next segment contains a discussion about a forecast marker. A man identified in the log as Councillor Pell asks whether it is operational. Ivo answers that the predicted pressure rise has appeared three times. Sera lifts a hand. Tomas pauses.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Repeating an observation three times is useful. It is not the same as proving the whole alarm system is ready. The route from measurement to warning can fail even if the instrument is right.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: That's what the temporary routing stamp was about.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Probably. We need the signoff to say for certain.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You find it in the engineering packet. A page titled TRIAL ACCEPTANCE AND HANDOVER bears Ivo's signature under SYSTEM READY FOR SUPERVISED USE. In the margin, another hand has written ALARM CHANNEL CROSS-TALK UNRESOLVED. The word supervised has been circled. Nobody has signed beside the unresolved item to show that it was cleared.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: He signed it anyway.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: He signed for supervised use with a known unresolved problem. We must keep the qualification. We must also ask what supervision actually existed when the storm arrived.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: I don't want the qualification to become a pillow people put over the rest.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Neither do I. Exact language can expose a failure more sharply than an accusation.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Respond to evidence of Ivo's involvement.

conversation.prompt: Respond to evidence of Ivo's involvement.
suggestions: His signature belongs in the public account.
What else do we need before describing his responsibility?
I can be his family and still help document this.
conversation.fallback: We need the operating conditions and the unedited instructions. His signature matters now; the remaining evidence will tell us how it mattered that night.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You remember Ivo teaching you to use a ruler without letting its damaged end define zero. Start at a clean mark, he said. Subtract the distance. A small lesson in correcting for a tool's imperfection. He knew so many small lessons. You want to ask the voice on the reel how many were needed before a person became good at the large ones.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: I don't think I knew him.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: You knew a person who was real. This part is real too. It doesn't have to erase the book repairs to change what they mean to you.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: For the first time, you are grateful that Tomas does not dislike your uncle cleanly. It would be easier for him and less useful to you. He has preserved the man's voice with more care than the man preserved the people in his report.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: There is another issue. The upper reservoir is climbing faster than the maintenance model allows. The forecast instrument may be interesting. The pressure vessel is becoming a current engineering problem.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Can we shut it down?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Not by closing the inlet blindly. That could trap the load. Nessa is getting the maintenance crew to inspect the gravity release and the downstream route. We have time to act carefully. That is a resource, not reassurance.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Review the evidence before continuing.

activity.prompt: Which source contains ordinary historical recorded voices?
activity.explanation: The historical audio is a magnetic recording, not a message from a different year through the apparatus.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Sera brings the reservoir trend to the table before anyone begins the next reel. She has plotted the readings against the maintenance limit and marked the forecast storm range separately. The two lines are not the same sort of information. One describes measurements already taken. The other describes a bounded expectation of what may arrive.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: I want the shutdown discussion to happen before we are rushed. The apparatus is becoming less safe as the differential rises. The gravity bypass is the designed relief route, subject to the inspection already under way. If it works as drawn, equalizing the load is likely to destroy the resonant state.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: How likely?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: The inclusion is already microfractured. Its stress history and the old maintenance warnings both point that way. I can't give a responsible percentage from the available evidence. I can say preserving operation would require accepting additional unquantified risk.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Could we reduce the pressure without losing the effect?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Perhaps under a controlled study, in a different setting, with time to test. Tonight we have a storm, aged hardware, and people nearby. A desirable research question is not an alternative safety plan.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Tomas leans back. He is not arguing for danger. He is allowing himself to feel the magnitude of what may be lost. You appreciate that Sera does not dismiss the feeling as irrational. Unique things can matter, even when they cannot be allowed to dictate the decision.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: If we preserve the housing, drawings, traces, and data, we still preserve something extraordinary.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Yes. We preserve what we actually know. We may lose the ability to repeat it here.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Which means people may always argue about whether it happened.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: They may. Operating a hazardous system to prevent skepticism is not an acceptable safety objective.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: The sentence costs her more than her even voice suggests. She rests a finger on the trend line, then removes it as though she has been caught trying to hold the measurement down.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: You would like independent observers here before the release.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Desperately. I would like a laboratory, a grant, six months of baseline data, and a world considerate enough to schedule its impossible phenomena during settled weather.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: We can offer a kettle and a man with two spare memory cards.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Then we use those resources well.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You list what can be preserved safely before any operation: calibrated photographs of the apparatus, original diagrams, raw sensor readings, synchronized timestamps, unedited video, source hashes, and a clear account of every intervention. You list what cannot be promised: a complete theory, unrestricted repeatability, survival of the active effect, universal agreement.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Do we need to keep the receiving paper in the tower while the input operates?

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: The apparatus uses its own paper path. We can photograph it in place and preserve the original after shutdown if access is safe. We should not dismantle part of a coupled mechanism merely to make a nicer exhibit before we finish operating it.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: So observation copies first, originals when safe.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Yes. The same conservation principle as a fire-damaged building. Nobody enters a dangerous structure because the object inside is unique.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You think of the box of cup fragments. They are easy to preserve because nothing depends on the cup continuing to hold pencils. The chronograph is more difficult because its function is part of what makes it significant. Yet function is not an entitlement. A device can become an artifact when continuing to use it costs too much.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Ivo may have believed keeping it working was the same as keeping the truth alive.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Or that its usefulness would eventually outweigh what he did. We need evidence before deciding which story he told himself.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Either way, we should not inherit the decision by default.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You draw a line through the phrase save the machine in your notes and replace it with preserve evidence; make installation safe. The revised objectives can be achieved together. The original phrase had concealed a conflict inside a single attractive verb.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Tomas asks whether dismantling the active effect will make the historical investigation harder. Sera explains that the 1998 operational findings rest on logs, charts, and ordinary recordings, not on a modern demonstration of the time effect. Establishing the old staff's belief in the instrument may matter to context; their handling of instructions can be evaluated from ordinary records.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: So no one can reasonably say that destroying the resonator destroys the case about the wrong rescue route.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: They could say it. We can show why the sources don't depend on it.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Exactly. We don't need everyone to be reasonable before making the record robust.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Sera marks an uncertainty on the mechanical diagram: a corroded fastener near the gate linkage. The inspection crew is checking it now. If it fails, the release procedure changes. The team has a written fallback involving isolation and a controlled manual gate operation from a protected access point. It would require qualified crew and a larger evacuation perimeter, not improvisation by the three of you.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: We don't need to understand that whole procedure to know when to stop ours.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: Correct. Our decision boundary is the verified checklist. A failed prerequisite sends the job back to the people qualified for the alternative. It does not invite us to become more heroic.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Tomas copies that sentence into the operations notes. You can imagine it becoming a line people quote later. You can also imagine the more important possibility: nobody quotes it because the procedure simply works.

requiredPassages.speaker: sera
requiredPassages.text: There is one more thing. After shutdown, no secret attempt to restart it. Not by me, not by a visiting team, not by somebody who thinks a final message might be waiting.

requiredPassages.speaker: ada
requiredPassages.text: Agreed.

requiredPassages.speaker: tomas
requiredPassages.text: Agreed. If we need a policy for access, we write one with the owner and the harbor.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: You make the agreement explicit in the site handover notes. The damaged pressure path will remain isolated until qualified assessment and authorization. You are preserving a question without preserving the right of any curious person to put others at risk in pursuit of it.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Outside, the light over the harbor has begun to flatten into the silver that precedes heavy rain. The apparatus may be the only one of its kind. The people moving along the quay are also the only people of their particular kinds. The comparison is sentimental if left there, so you return to the numbers, the checks, and the list of work that can actually protect them.

requiredPassages.speaker: narrator
requiredPassages.text: Review the evidence before continuing.

options: Preserve evidence and make the installation safe.
Keep it active until every skeptic agrees.
activity.explanation: Records can be preserved independently; scientific curiosity does not authorize additional unsafe operation.
